en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4502 - Sulaiman ibn Dawud al-Minqari narrated from Hafs ibn Ghiyath or another person, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who divorced his wife, and they had a child between them. Which of them has more right to the child?
Imam (as) said: "The mother, as long as she does not remarry."
